answer: The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in lantern, expire in ferrous, and shale lists each expiry. An adversary running 120 aliases as a result needs 178 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 198 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
